instruction: Block all cookies in Chrome's privacy and security settings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to navigate to Chrome privacy settings and disable cookies for all sites. Evaluator verifies by checking the Chrome Preferences file profile.default_content_setting_values.cookies field (2=block). Custom getter function get_chrome_cookies_setting__1d96da57 returns 'block' or 'allow'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to block cookies in Chrome
Getter logic correctly reads Chrome Preferences file from appropriate OS-specific locations (Windows/macOS/Linux)
Getter correctly interprets cookies setting value (2=block, 1=allow) and returns appropriate string
Metric (exact_match) correctly compares getter result with expected value 'block'
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches Chrome to ensure settings are persisted to disk before evaluation
Complete coverage: single requirement (block cookies) is fully verified
Error handling is robust: returns 'allow' on failure (conservative default)
No logical issues or missing edge cases identified
